title: License identification from text/headers
description: License texts and file headers are scanned for SPDX identifiers and known license phrases. Identification runs on every ingested dataset so nothing enters the archive with unknown rights. Unidentified licenses are treated as all-rights-reserved until clarified. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers SPDX identifier scanning.
kind: data license and usage rights checker
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT", 2: "licensed under Apache-2.0", 3: "no license mentioned"}
import re
text = CFG[LEVEL]
m = re.search(r"SPDX-License-Identifier:\s*(\S+)", text) or re.search(r"(?i)\b(MIT|Apache-2\.0|GPL-3\.0)\b", text)
print("text:", text, "| license:", m.group(1) if m else "UNKNOWN -> all-rights-reserved")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: License compatibility matrix
description: Combining datasets requires compatible licenses: the matrix answers whether license A and license B can be mixed in one derivative. Incompatible combinations are blocked before the merge, not discovered in a lawsuit. The matrix is maintained as data and reviewed by counsel. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers pairwise compatibility lookups.

title: Obligation extraction
description: Each license's obligations are extracted into a checklist: attribution required, share-alike, notice preservation, patent grants. The checklist travels with the dataset so downstream users inherit the obligations, not just the data. Unmet obligations are flagged before publication. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers checklists per license.

title: License change detection
description: Upstream datasets can be relicensed; the checker watches for changes and alerts when a new version carries different terms. Relicensing can silently remove rights the archive depends on. Detected changes pause ingestion until reviewed. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers watching upstream license terms.
kind: data license and usage rights checker
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: ("MIT", "MIT"), 2: ("MIT", "GPL-3.0"), 3: ("Apache-2.0", "Apache-2.0")}
old, new = CFG[LEVEL]
print("license %s -> %s" % (old, new), "|", "no change" if old == new else "RELICENSED: ingestion paused for review")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.
